title: Riddle: write on your reMarkable, watch the AI reply animate back stroke by stroke

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Riddle turns a remarkable tablet into Tom Riddle's enchanted diary. You write with the pen, the page drinks your ink, and a reply writes itself back in flowing script. Chatting with an AI on an e- in device usually means a laggy keyboard and a chat bubble UI that kills the whole feel. This reads your raw handwriting straight off the pen, sends the committed page to a resident ondevice model, and animates the answer stroke by stroke.
